game_concept: A puzzle set in Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip, a shipyard building boats: the fisher must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Shipyard Slip: a shipyard building boats
core_gameplay_loop: In Shipyard Slip, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the profit value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the dock crane using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the dock crane is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Shipyard Slip'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Shipyard Slip.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The dock crane reached with actions_used <= 18.
